info.title: How to play
info.connections.heading: Connections
info.connections.body:
You get a grid of shuffled words. Sort them into equal-sized groups. Every puzzle tells you how many groups and how many words in each.

There is only one correct grouping. A word may look like it fits two categories, but that's the trap.

Pick the number of words the Submit button asks for. If you're wrong, try again. Depending on the puzzle, you'll have a fixed number of mistakes or unlimited tries. Pick all but one correctly and the game says "One away!"

Groups are color-coded from easiest to hardest.
info.strands.heading: Strands
info.strands.body:
You get a grid of letters and a theme clue. Find the theme words hidden in the grid. Each word is a chain of adjacent letters, in any direction including diagonals. No letter is used twice within one word.

Every cell belongs to exactly one theme word, so the whole board fills up when you're done.

The spangram is the special word that names the theme and stretches from one side of the grid to the opposite side. Find it to reveal the theme.

Stuck? Tap Hint to light up the letters of one unfound theme word. Hints are free.

To pick a word, drag across letters or tap them in order. Double-tap the last letter to submit, or press the Submit button. Tap a letter already in your path to backtrack.

catfishing.editor.title: Editor
catfishing.editor.lede: Build a Catfishing set: five HP entities, guessed from the Fandom categories they belong to.
catfishing.editor.questions.heading: Questions
catfishing.editor.questions.help: A set is exactly five questions. Pick an entity, review its clues, and give each a Vietnamese translation. Difficulty is an internal tag — players never see it. Suggested mix: 2 easy, 2 medium, 1 hard.

catfishing.editor.entityPicker.label: Entity
catfishing.editor.entityPicker.help: Selecting an entity fills the answer, aliases, difficulty, and clue list from the HP Wiki catalog.
catfishing.editor.answer.aliasesHelp: Comma-separated. Extra spellings the matcher should accept as correct (e.g. Hermione, Hermione Jean Granger).
catfishing.editor.difficulty.label: Difficulty (internal)
catfishing.editor.difficulty.help: How well-known the answer is to a general HP audience — not how hard the clues are. Never shown to players.
